layout.arrangement: Title slide: white outer canvas with a large red-outlined light-gray slide panel inset on all sides (panel is clipped at the bottom edge of the frame). All text is center-aligned in a vertical stack in the middle of the panel: main title 'Transformers', subtitle 'Part I' beneath it, date 'Aug. 2020' beneath that. A small yellow circular slide-number badge sits in the top-right corner inside the panel. A tiny '+' crosshair artifact appears just left of center below the date.

Title 'Transformers' is very large and bold; 'Part I' is bold and roughly 45-50% of the title size; 'Aug. 2020' is bold italic and slightly smaller than 'Part I'. All text is the same red color and center-aligned. No all-caps styling; numeral '2' in badge is small regular-weight dark text.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF). 2. Draw a rectangle spanning ~4% to ~96% horizontally and ~7% to ~100% vertically (let it bleed off the bottom edge); fill light gray (#E9E9E7), border dark red (#C00000), ~2pt weight. 3. Center a text box at ~42% vertical with 'Transformers' in Arial Bold, ~66pt, red (#C00000), centered. 4. Below it add 'Part I' in Arial Bold, ~32pt, same red, centered. 5. Below that add 'Aug. 2020' in Arial Bold Italic, ~20pt, same red, centered. 6. In the top-right of the gray panel (~92% horizontal, ~13% vertical), draw a small ellipse ~0.5in diameter: fill pale yellow (#FDFD96), outline purple (#6A5ACD) ~1.5pt, with centered text '2' in ~12pt dark gray/black. 7. Optionally add a tiny gray '+' text mark just left of center below the date to match the artifact, or omit as it is likely a cursor artifact. 8. No other elements, bullets, charts, or images.
